rows.note: Use 作家 as the all-purpose noun for a writer understood as an author, especially one producing literary work.

example.english: I want to become a writer.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 go3 zok3 gaa1

rows.note: Use 作者 when identifying the author or creator of a particular book, article, song, or other work.

example.english: The writer of this book is from Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢本書嘅作者係一位香港人。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zok3 ze2 hai6 jat1 wai2 hoeng1 gong2 jan4

rows.note: Use 寫手 for someone who writes professionally, especially commercial, online, or commissioned material.

example.english: This company hired a writer to help write advertisements.
example.traditional: 呢間公司請咗個寫手幫手寫廣告。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 cing2 zo2 go3 se2 sau2 bong1 sau2 se2 gwong2 gou3

rows.note: Use this productive noun phrase with V set to 寫嘢 when you simply mean the person who writes, rather than an established author.

example.english: Someone who writes isn't necessarily a writer.
example.traditional: 寫嘢嘅人唔一定係作家。
example.jyutping: se2 je5 ge3 jan4 m4 jat1 ding6 hai6 zok3 gaa1
